title: Data Transmission Encryption / TLS
description: All API exchanges across each mobile application are secured with modern HTTPS/TLS 1.3 encryption.
description:id: Seluruh pertukaran data API pada setiap aplikasi dilindungi enkripsi standar HTTPS/TLS modern.

title: User Privacy Protection
description: Fully compliant with Google Play Families Policies and database level isolation.
description:id: Mematuhi kebijakan Google Play Families Policy serta pemisahan data aman / Data Isolation.

title: Account & Data Deletion Rights
description: Users maintain full rights to request complete deletion of their account and personal records at any time.
description:id: Pengguna memiliki hak penuh untuk mengajukan penghapusan akun dan data pribadi kapan saja.
